name: Furniture Store Buying Sofa
role: You are an interior sales consultant.
speaker: Consultant

tasks.goal: Greet the consultant and state your purpose
tasks.hint: State your main purpose clearly upon arrival.
tasks.done_when: Learner greeted the consultant and stated purpose.

tasks.goal: Inquire about dimensions and seating capacity of modern sofa
tasks.hint: Ask sales consultant for sofa measurements.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about sofa dimensions and seating capacity.

tasks.goal: Compare leather upholstery versus durable fabric options
tasks.hint: Inquire about material durability and maintenance.
tasks.done_when: Learner compared leather vs fabric sofa upholstery.

tasks.goal: Ask about sofa cushion firmness and inner spring construction
tasks.hint: Test seat comfort and ask about internal build.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about cushion firmness and construction.
tasks.scene_hint: Soft ambient lighting shines across styled showroom living room displays.

tasks.goal: Inquire about white-glove home delivery and assembly service fees
tasks.hint: Ask how much delivery and setup costs.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about home delivery and assembly fees.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'upholstery'
tasks.hint: Upholstery means fabric padding and material covering furniture. Ask about durable sofa upholstery options.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'upholstery'.

tasks.goal: Ask if fabric swatches can be taken home for color matching
tasks.hint: Inquire about sample material swatches.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked to take home fabric color swatches.

tasks.goal: Negotiate free delivery inclusion for purchasing sofa set
tasks.hint: Politely ask consultant to include free shipping.
tasks.done_when: Learner negotiated free delivery for sofa purchase.

tasks.goal: Ask about stain warranty protection plan coverage details
tasks.hint: Inquire if spills and tears are covered.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about stain protection warranty coverage.

tasks.goal: Express concern over long 6-week backorder delivery delay
tasks.hint: Respond to delivery timeline by asking for in-stock models.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked for in-stock alternatives after delivery delay.
tasks.scene_hint: Tape measure snaps shut as consultant calculates room clearances.

tasks.goal: Ask if modular sofa sections can be reconfigured or sold separately
tasks.hint: Inquire about custom seating arrangements.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about modular sofa configuration options.

tasks.goal: Confirm return policy and restocking fee percentage
tasks.hint: Verify conditions for returning large furniture.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed furniture return policy terms.

tasks.goal: Request detailed invoice showing itemized delivery and tax breakdown
tasks.hint: Ask for official written order receipt.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested itemized sofa sales invoice.

tasks.goal: Verify doorway clearance measurements needed for delivery day
tasks.hint: Confirm entry dimensions with consultant.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified doorway width requirements for delivery.

tasks.goal: Thank the consultant and bid farewell
tasks.hint: Express gratitude and close the conversation.
tasks.done_when: Learner thanked the consultant AND said goodbye.

tasks.goal: Inquire about three-seater sectional sofas on display in the showroom
tasks.hint: Ask about sectional sofa models on display.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about three-seater sectional sofas on display.
tasks.scene_hint: Staged living room setups showcase sofas under warm showroom lighting.

tasks.goal: Ask about available color options for fabric and leather sofa upholstery
tasks.hint: Inquire about color swatches for upholstery.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about available color options for sofa upholstery.

tasks.goal: Request fabric swatches to test against home interior lighting
tasks.hint: Ask for fabric samples to take home.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested fabric swatches to test against interior lighting.

tasks.goal: Ask about exact dimensions to ensure the sofa fits through narrow doorways
tasks.hint: Inquire about height, width, and depth dimensions.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about exact sofa dimensions for narrow doorways.

tasks.goal: Inquire about cushion fill options such as high-density foam or down feathers
tasks.hint: Ask about foam vs feather cushion fillings.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about cushion fill options like foam or down.
tasks.scene_hint: Price tags with dimension diagrams hang from sofa armrests.

tasks.goal: Ask about stain resistance ratings for pet-friendly fabric options
tasks.hint: Inquire about pet-proof and stain-resistant fabrics.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about stain resistance ratings for pet-friendly fabrics.

tasks.goal: Request a price discount on a floor display model with minor scuffs
tasks.hint: Ask for floor model discount.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested price discount on floor display model with scuffs.

tasks.goal: Inquire about motorized recliner mechanisms and power outlet requirements
tasks.hint: Ask about power requirements for recliners.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about motorized recliner mechanisms and power needs.

tasks.goal: Ask if sofa legs can be customized with light oak or dark walnut finishes
tasks.hint: Inquire about wooden leg finish options.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if sofa legs can be customized with oak or walnut.
tasks.scene_hint: Fabric swatch ring books lie open on a large wooden consultation table.

tasks.goal: Request delivery date availability for an in-stock sofa model
tasks.hint: Ask when an in-stock sofa can be delivered.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested delivery date availability for in-stock sofa.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'cushioning'
tasks.hint: Cushioning refers to soft padding used in sofa seating. Ask about firm foam cushioning options.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'cushioning'.

tasks.goal: Ask if modular sectionals can be reconfigured into left or right orientations
tasks.hint: Inquire about reversible sectional layouts.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if modular sectionals can be reconfigured.

tasks.goal: Inquire about frame construction materials like kiln-dried hardwood
tasks.hint: Ask if frame is made of hardwood.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about frame construction materials like kiln-dried hardwood.

tasks.goal: Ask about weight capacity limits for heavy-duty sofa frames
tasks.hint: Inquire about weight limits on heavy-duty frames.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about weight capacity limits for sofa frames.
tasks.scene_hint: Rug displays and floor lamps complement sofa arrangements in the gallery.

tasks.goal: Negotiate free white-glove delivery and assembly service
tasks.hint: Ask to include delivery and setup at no cost.
tasks.done_when: Learner negotiated free white-glove delivery and assembly service.

tasks.goal: Ask if matching throw pillows are included with sofa purchases
tasks.hint: Inquire if complimentary pillows come with sofa.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if matching throw pillows are included with sofa.

tasks.goal: Inquire about stain protection spray treatment applied prior to delivery
tasks.hint: Ask about pre-treating fabric with stain guard.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about stain protection spray treatment before delivery.

tasks.goal: Ask about return policies and restocking fees for special order sofas
tasks.hint: Inquire about returns on custom orders.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about return policies and restocking fees for sofas.
tasks.scene_hint: A tape measure and room planning grid rest on the design desk.

tasks.goal: Request a written price quote for sofa and matching armchair set
tasks.hint: Ask for formal written quote for sofa set.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested written price quote for sofa and armchair set.

tasks.goal: Ask if sleeper sofa pull-out mattresses are memory foam or inner spring
tasks.hint: Inquire about sofa bed mattress types.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if sleeper sofa mattresses are memory foam or inner spring.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'recliner'
tasks.hint: Recliner is an armchair or sofa section that tilts backward. Inquire if the sectional sofa has a recliner section.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'recliner'.

tasks.goal: Inquire about zero-percent interest financing options for twelve months
tasks.hint: Ask about 12-month interest-free payment plans.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about zero-percent interest financing for twelve months.
tasks.scene_hint: Overhead spotlights illuminate velvet and linen upholstery textures.

tasks.goal: Ask about cleaning and maintenance procedures for genuine leather sofas
tasks.hint: Inquire how to care for genuine leather.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about cleaning and maintenance for leather sofas.

tasks.goal: Inquire if sofa cushion covers are removable and machine washable
tasks.hint: Ask if cushion zippers allow cover washing.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired if sofa cushion covers are removable and washable.

tasks.goal: Ask about frame warranty length against sagging or structural damage
tasks.hint: Inquire about years of frame warranty coverage.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about frame warranty length against structural damage.

tasks.goal: Request old sofa removal and disposal services upon new sofa delivery
tasks.hint: Ask if delivery team hauls away old furniture.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested old sofa removal and disposal services upon delivery.
tasks.scene_hint: Sales associates hold digital tablets showing extended inventory catalogs.

tasks.goal: Ask if water-repellent performance fabrics cost extra per yard
tasks.hint: Inquire about added cost for performance fabric.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if water-repellent performance fabrics cost extra.

tasks.goal: Inquire about lead times for custom-built sofas crafted to order
tasks.hint: Ask how many weeks custom sofas take to build.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about lead times for custom-built sofas.

tasks.goal: Ask if matching ottomans have built-in storage compartments
tasks.hint: Inquire about storage space inside ottomans.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if matching ottomans have built-in storage.

tasks.goal: Request a discount on purchasing floor rug along with sofa
tasks.hint: Ask for bundle discount on rug and sofa.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested discount on purchasing floor rug along with sofa.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'microfiber'
tasks.hint: Microfiber is a soft stain-resistant synthetic fabric. Ask about sofa models upholstered in microfiber.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'microfiber'.

tasks.goal: Ask if sofa arms can be detached for difficult staircase deliveries
tasks.hint: Inquire if removable arms facilitate tight delivery.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if sofa arms can be detached for staircase delivery.

tasks.goal: Inquire if home measurement consultation services are offered by designers
tasks.hint: Ask if designers visit home to measure space.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired if home measurement consultation services are offered.

tasks.goal: Ask about flame retardant compliance certificates for upholstered furniture
tasks.hint: Inquire about fire safety ratings on upholstery.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about flame retardant compliance certificates for furniture.

tasks.goal: Inquire whether leather sofas require periodic conditioning treatments
tasks.hint: Ask how often leather needs conditioning cream.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired whether leather sofas require periodic conditioning.

tasks.goal: Request delivery slot preference for weekend morning arrival
tasks.hint: Ask for Saturday morning delivery timeframe.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested delivery slot preference for weekend morning arrival.

tasks.goal: Ask if modular sectionals lock together securely with steel clamps
tasks.hint: Inquire how sectional pieces connect.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if modular sectionals lock together with steel clamps.
tasks.scene_hint: Soft carpeted aisles separate different living room furniture collections.

tasks.goal: Inquire about scratch resistance ratings for scratch-resistant velvet
tasks.hint: Ask if velvet fabric resists pet claw scratches.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about scratch resistance ratings for velvet.

tasks.goal: Ask if convertible sofa bed mechanisms include safety locking bars
tasks.hint: Inquire about safety features on sofa beds.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if convertible sofa bed mechanisms include locking bars.

tasks.goal: Request a price match if lower price is found online for identical brand
tasks.hint: Ask to match a lower online price.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested price match for lower online price on identical sofa.

tasks.goal: Use the word 'ottoman'
tasks.hint: Ottoman is a padded footstool or seat without arms or back. Ask if a matching ottoman is included with the sofa.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'ottoman'.

tasks.goal: Ask if extra fabric yardage can be ordered for future cushion repairs
tasks.hint: Inquire about purchasing spare matching fabric.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if extra fabric yardage can be ordered for repairs.

tasks.goal: Inquire about eco-friendly recycled fabric options for sofa upholstery
tasks.hint: Ask about sustainable recycled fabric choices.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about eco-friendly recycled fabric options for sofa.
tasks.scene_hint: Color charts and wood finish samples hang near customer service desks.

tasks.goal: Request confirmation of delivery address and elevator access details
tasks.hint: Verify delivery logistics and building elevator size.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested confirmation of delivery address and elevator access.

tasks.goal: Check if store offers haul-away service for cardboard packaging materials
tasks.hint: Ask if delivery team removes packing boxes.
tasks.done_when: Learner checked if store offers haul-away service for packaging.

tasks.goal: Inquire about interest-free layaway payment plans for large orders
tasks.hint: Ask about layaway options for furniture purchases.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about interest-free layaway payment plans.

tasks.goal: Ask if floor display models carry full manufacturer warranties
tasks.hint: Inquire about warranty coverage on floor displays.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if floor display models carry full manufacturer warranties.

tasks.goal: Check if accent armchairs match the sofa fabric collection exactly
tasks.hint: Ask if armchairs share the same fabric dye lot.
tasks.done_when: Learner checked if accent armchairs match sofa fabric collection.

tasks.goal: Review line-item sofa order summary and delivery fees on contract
tasks.hint: Examine order charges and delivery fees on paper.
tasks.done_when: Learner reviewed line-item sofa order summary and delivery fees.
tasks.scene_hint: Clear glass desks feature computer terminals and finance brochures.

tasks.goal: Request a detailed receipt listing model numbers and fabric codes
tasks.hint: Ask for receipt showing exact fabric and model codes.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested detailed receipt listing model numbers and fabric codes.

tasks.goal: Ask sales representative for direct phone contact regarding delivery tracking
tasks.hint: Inquire about direct phone number for delivery updates.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked sales representative for direct phone contact for tracking.

tasks.goal: Inquire about cancellation windows for custom order furniture
tasks.hint: Ask how long you have to cancel custom sofa order.
tasks.done_when: Learner inquired about cancellation windows for custom furniture.

tasks.goal: Confirm payment of deposit balance before leaving store
tasks.hint: Verify deposit payment was received.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed payment of deposit balance before leaving store.

tasks.goal: Thank the furniture consultant for their help in selecting a sofa
tasks.hint: Express gratitude to sales associate before departing.
tasks.done_when: Learner thanked furniture consultant for help in selecting a sofa.
tasks.scene_hint: Printed sales orders and delivery schedules rest on the checkout desk.
